title: Old Donut SMP Scoreboard
description: Brings back the old Donut SMP scoreboard
body:
Donut SMP recently changed their scoreboard, and a lot of players (including me) thought the new one looked bad. This mod brings the old Donut SMP scoreboard back exactly the layout, colors, and icons you remember purely client-side.

It reads your real stats from the server's current scoreboard and re-renders them in the old style. Everything updates live.

How to use it

1. Drop this mod into your mods folder
2. Launch Minecraft and join Donut SMP
3. Make sure the server's scoreboard is enabled (so the mod has data to read) it'll automatically hide the new one and show the classic version
